promptingStudio.combinedPromptTemplate:
Scene: An international travel essay sound studio. Crisp clean acoustic treatment, forward voice presence conveying authentic warmth and genuine discovery.
Sample Context: Appreciative, vibrant, immersive, and informative. Rhythms reflect the bustling street life and serene rural landscapes of modern Vietnam.

Speaker 1 - Vietnam Travel Documentarian (Chris / Brian):
centuries of change and endurance. It is a land carved by monsoon rains, softened by the morning mist, and brightened by the golden light that spills across endless rice fields. This is a place of striking contrasts and quiet strength. This is Vietnam. From the vantage point of a soaring heron, the country appears as a living tapestry. Terrace hillsides rising in green waves, rivers winding through fertile deltas and cities pulsing with the energy of a million lives in motion.
